_readme: Source for the homepage card spans (build_bits.py) and, later, the technology index. One row per piece. kind: inning | away | notes. status: wip | on-wax ('on wax' is earned-only — set it when the piece is done). url blank = a slot, rendered as a non-link card. Inning rows are seeded from the run's proposed lineup (wax-system: nbtv-brand/shares/keeping-score-content-map.md § 8, 9/16); edit here as each inning is ruled, then rerun the generator. [[word]] in a title renders as the gold span.
